Title: Promptuario manual mexicano, que a la verdad podrá ser utilissimo a los parrochos para la enseñanza, a los necessitados indios para su instruccion, y a los que aprenden la lengua para la expedicion
Creator: Ignacio de Paredes, S.J., of the Colegio de San Gregorio for the Indians, Mexico City
Publisher: México: en la Imprenta de la Bibliotheca Mexicana, enfrente de San Augustin, 1759
Publication Date: 1759
Rights: Public Domain (published 1759, more than 95 years ago; public domain by date under the project's rolling rule; the item carries no rights field, so the date rule alone applies)
Language: nci
Source: Internet Archive item promptuariomanua00pare (https://archive.org/details/promptuariomanua00pare), the item's own promptuariomanua00pare_djvu.txt full-text OCR derivative; contributing library per the item metadata: John Carter Brown Library; host metadata date: 1759. Fetched directly (curl/urllib, raw bytes) by the Library thread (Era VIII pass), 2026-10-23. sha256 of the raw fetched bytes: af1b477303ef46f34707fa6924c474ea23df5df068b6ddb5f3df019c7945c173.
Provenance note: Header prepended by the Library thread; nothing else altered, no OCR error corrected, nothing retyped. John Carter Brown Library scan; usable OCR of Nahuatl with Spanish glosses in brackets, long s read as f, and a garbled cover.
Content note: Forty-six Nahuatl talks (platicas) with their exempla for the Sundays of the year, explaining the Christian doctrine to parishioners, and six Lenten sermons, ending with a sermon on Our Lady of Guadalupe with a short account of her story; the parish preaching of eighteenth-century New Spain in the language of its hearers.
